name: DRAFT - NOT APPROVED - EXPERIMENTAL - XAUUSD provider S_TP4 M5 E2
description: Conservative experimental forward-test CANDIDATE from the 2026-10-21 signal-provider research. UNAPPROVED research draft with NO demonstrated positive expectancy: the out-of-sample 95% bootstrap CI for the mean R spans zero (n=68 fills, simulated on Dukascopy ticks, not Vantage). Must not be activated without owner review and explicit authorization. Demo or paper use only. See recommendations.audit_warning: edit-timing audit found no edge on text-stable signals.

source.author: Claude research run (Haiku 5.5 xhigh subagents, coordinated)
source.notes: Research candidate S_TP4|M5 (100% close at TP4, break-even at +4.0 USD) under entry model E2 (project pending_at_range). Simulated on Dukascopy XAUUSD ticks, MID cost scenario, clean signals. Not an MT5 Strategy Tester report. Broker symbol and account specs unverified.

recommendations.not_executed: Recommendations are informational and never executed. The profile stays inactive until an operator approves and activates it.

research_basis.candidate: S_TP4|M5: 100% close at TP4, break-even at +4.0 USD
research_basis.entry_model: E2 = project pending_at_range: market if inside range +/-0.5 USD, else limit at the unfavourable range edge, valid 60 min
research_basis.data: Simulated on Dukascopy XAUUSD ticks (not Vantage). Clean signals. OOS = last 81 signals, 2026-08-17 to 2026-09-24. Contract size 100 oz assumed (unverified).

recommendations.evidence_summary: OOS E2, n=68 fills: mean +0.20R, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.33, +0.80], PF 1.37, closed max DD 13.5R, block-bootstrap p95 DD 30.8R, 38% break-even exits. Every OOS CI spans zero. Holm p = 1.0. White Reality Check vs zero p = 0.22 (E2). Mean falls to -0.40R after removing the top 5 winners, so the positive mean rests on a few large TP4 winners. TP4-only trades exist only on the 72-77% of signals that carry a TP4. In-sample (TRAIN+VAL, E2, S_TP4 without BE): +0.20R, n=233.
known_gaps: Broker symbol unresolved: broker_symbol is the placeholder UNVERIFIED-XAUUSD. The real Vantage name was not read (the bridge SYMBOL_INFO was not called). The terminal rejects unknown symbols, so entries are skipped as symbol_not_mapped until the operator sets the true name.

Account and contract specs unverified: equity, leverage, margin, commission, contract size, tick value, volume min/step/max. Sizing assumes 1 lot = 100 oz and 1.00 USD per 0.01 price step per lot, which are the research placeholders, not Vantage values.

Spread gate: the research simulation applied no spread gate (as far as the files read show). 1.0 was chosen from the spread distribution: Dukascopy spread median 0.68 USD, 7.2% of ticks <= 0.50, 91.5% <= 1.00. Default safety max_spread_price 0.5 would block about 93% of ticks, so the profile is refused until settings/default.safety.max_spread_price is at least 1.0 (owner decision; safety was not changed here).

Edits untested: 411 of 415 signals (99%) were edited, and their original text is unrecoverable, so whether edits changed entry, SL or TP is unknown. The history has no provider cancellations, so explicit_cancel is untested.

Costs: the research tables use MID costs, which the reports do not define. BASE (no extra spread or slippage) and PESS (+0.20 USD spread, +0.10 USD slippage, latency 15 s) are defined. STRATEGY_COMPARISON.md gives E2 PESS +0.18R (n=68) for 'the TP4 variants' without naming the BE setting. A PESS figure for this exact BE variant is not in the files read. Real Vantage costs are unknown.

Concurrency: research R figures assume every filled signal is taken. max_concurrent_positions 1 skips a signal that arrives while another trade is open. In the strict-entry sample (68 fills, SIGNAL_PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md section 3), 10 signals arrived while an earlier fill was open; they won TP1-before-SL 30% of the time, against 60% otherwise. E2 overlap is not reported in the files read. The effect of this skip is not simulated.
Not expressible in the schema: runner positions (the final checkpoint always closes the remaining volume) and time stops (no horizon field). Those variants are excluded from this draft.
Break-even: research moves the stop to entry when price is 4.0 USD in favour. The AutoTrader checks the broker price on each lifecycle pass, not on every tick, so triggers can be late.
Sizing: 0.25% risk trades 100% of signals only from about 5,000 USD equity (about 3.9% at 1,000 USD, 0% at 500 USD) with below_min_volume skip. Single-TP exits need only 0.01 lots.
activation_blockers: Set symbols[0].broker_symbol to the exact name shown in MT5 Market Watch. The placeholder cannot resolve.
Owner decision: raise settings/default.safety.max_spread_price to at least 1.0, or lower limits.max_spread_price to the owner's chosen gate (that changes the research basis).
Verify demo-account equity, leverage, contract size, tick value and volume min/step/max, then re-check the sizing preview.
Owner review and explicit authorization to approve and activate. Activation needs status approved, validateProfile ok and no validateProfileAgainstSafety issues.
Decide the edit and cancel policy. It is untested in research.
recommendations.forward_test_advice: Demo or paper only, with owner authorization. Record every signal with its decision and skip reason. Compare realised R with the research OOS distribution before drawing any conclusion. At n=68 the research could detect a mean of about 1.0R, so a small forward sample cannot confirm or refute an edge. Keep the kill switch on until the owner approves activation.
recommendations.validation_note: Validated in memory with version 1 injected. See docs/research/signal_provider/2026-10-21/profile_validation_output.txt. The stored file omits version, as the schema requires.
recommendations.audit_warning: AUDIT WARNING (independent audit, exploratory, 2026-10): the positive OOS mean of this research family comes entirely from signals whose text was edited MORE than 5 minutes after posting (about 25% of signals; 80% of them already had TP1 touched before the edit). Among signals whose text was stable within 5 minutes (about 75%), modeled mean R is NEGATIVE for every tested exit (MID costs, E2: 100% TP1 -0.31R n=283; S_TP4|M0 -0.22R n=225; S_TP4|M5 -0.25R n=225). Original pre-edit levels are unrecoverable, so late edits may embed hindsight. Treat this profile as having NO demonstrated edge; it exists only as a documented, fail-closed research artifact. UPDATE 2026-10-24: a second out-of-sample test (58 signals, 2026-09-24..2026-10-22) gave -0.66R for this exact candidate (E2, MID costs, n=53, CI [-0.79,-0.52]); the earlier +0.20R did not replicate. Use only for an operations test on the demo account, with no profit expectation. See OOS2_AND_LIVE_CROSSCHECK.md.
